name: – After § 2 – Am 2
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a standing committee on Security and Defence and a standing committee on Public Health
part_text: 2a. Decides that the standing committee’s activities shall not reduce security and defence to military aspects, and shall instead take into account other forms of security such as collective security principles, arms control and disarmament, de-escalation of armed conflicts, diplomacy, as well as food security, a safe environment and access to health;
